description:
The form includes a required field identified internally as **height** and displayed to users with the label **“Height (in inches)”**.  Respondents are asked to *Enter the person's height in inches. Provide a range if uncertain*, and the input box shows the placeholder **e.g., 70**.  If they need additional guidance they can click the link labeled **Learn more**, which points to https://example.com/height-info.  For privacy considerations this field is marked with a **moderate** PII impact.  The acceptable range is defined by a minimum height of **60** inches and a maximum height of **80** inches.  

When the form is submitted, the answer from this field will be stored under the dynamic field list **cf** (the default mapping for custom fields).
